am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding my recent experience when attempting to register and access services at this GP surgery.
When I attended in person to register, two reception staff members were engaged in a personal conversation while several patients were waiting in the queue. After waiting several minutes, I politely asked for the registration forms. I was told to wait while they continued their conversation for several more minutes. When I was eventually called, I was given the form with a very poor and dismissive attitude.
When I returned with the completed paperwork, the registration process was repeatedly delayed without clear justification. I was asked for an excessive number of documents, one after another, despite already providing valid identification, including my driving licence and immigration status. I was required to attend the surgery twice, with no clear explanation for the repeated requests.
In addition, I have been unable to access the surgery by telephone. I have been calling for over four consecutive days from 8:00am, as instructed. Before 8:00am, the message states calls open at 8:00; after 8:00am, the line is either unavailable for over an hour or, when answered, I am told that the urgent appointment window has already passed and that I must call again another day.
Given that I am suffering from ongoing and severe pain and urgently need GP care, this lack of access, poor communication, and unprofessional behaviour is extremely concerning.
I would appreciate this complaint being reviewed and appropriate action taken to ensure patients are treated with respect and are able to access care in a reasonable and fair
